title: Campaign: human motor cortex structure, stability across days, years and people
abstract: Branch B of the human motor cortex structure campaign asks: Stability: which parts of motor cortex population structure and decoding persist across days, years and people, and which drift? It splits by the span of the comparison into leaves B1: Within a person, how do tuning, latent structure and decoding quality change with the time between sessions, and does a component persist for years?; B2: Across people, is there a shared latent movement structure that transfers decoding to a new participant? No results yet. Cite this campaign and name the leaf to contribute.

citations.reason: Hahn et al. 2026, Nature Medicine: 20-year performance of Utah arrays in 14 BrainGate participants; the main source of summary data.
